title: Construct Product Matrix
summary: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer matrix grid of size n * m, construct a 0-indexed 2D matrix p of the same size where each element p[i][j] is the product of all elements in grid, excluding grid[i][j], taken modulo 12345.
statement: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer matrix grid of size n * m, construct a 0-indexed 2D matrix p of the same size where each element p[i][j] is the product of all elements in grid, excluding grid[i][j], taken modulo 12345.
constraints: grid is a nonempty rectangular positive-integer matrix with at least two cells.
Each output cell is the product of every input cell except the corresponding one, modulo 12345.
Do not use modular division because excluded values may not be invertible.
hints: Division is unsafe under a composite modulus, but products before and after a cell are independent.
Flatten traversal conceptually and combine a suffix-exclusive pass with a prefix-exclusive pass.
Store the product after each cell, multiply by the product before it, and reduce modulo 12345 throughout.
Every other cell lies exactly in the prefix or suffix relative to the excluded position, so their product is included once without division.
editorial: Every other cell lies exactly in the prefix or suffix relative to the excluded position, so their product is included once without division.

tests.explanation: Excluding each value from total product twenty-four gives [[24,12],[8,6]].
Excluding 12345 gives two; every other product contains a zero-modulo factor.
